Process failure 2026-07-22 10am run: proposed a BUY in MU citing a same-day (2026-07-22) earnings reaction ('+12% today') sourced from a WebSearch AI-summary sentence, without cross-checking the actual event date against other dated sources in the same search batch or against repo data. data/earnings_calendar.json (already in the repo, last updated 2026-07-19) shows MU's last earnings was 2026-06-24 - nearly a month earlier - so the entire catalyst-timing narrative was wrong; the risk desk vetoed the trade on the resulting price-freshness inconsistency but for a narrower stated reason than the real root cause. RULE: before writing ANY 'today/yesterday/this week' framing about an event (earnings, guidance, 8-K, upgrade, analyst action) for ANY ticker - not just this run's deep-research focus names - check data/earnings_calendar.json (or the bundle's days_to_earnings/days_since_earnings for focus names) FIRST as the deterministic source of truth, and only then treat a WebSearch summary's date framing as corroboration, never as the primary source of when something happened.
